summary: Iteration 7: tested new finance batch end-to-end. Backend 19/20 pytest pass (taşeron normalization & site expense exclusion, categories/kasa_list, kasalar CRUD + system protection + in-use delete block, müşteri %6 virman create/remove on taslak/delete, taşeron no overhead, advance deduction + advance-balance + gross account balance, hakediş pay closes to odendi, duplicate detection + check-duplicate, WhatsApp template/parse (taşeron+müşteri)/inbound unknown phone TwiML, accounts active filter, planned 'cek' payment paid -> gider tx + check, idempotent re-pay, invalid type 400, dashboard/reports kasa list + kar_zarar.genel_gider, kasa excel export, settings distribution github validation, tx edit/delete regression). 1 failure: account statement running balance inconsistent with account balance when hakediş has advance_deduction. Frontend (desktop 1920 + mobile 390) all requested flows PASS. All TEST_ data cleaned up.

critical.issue: Hakediş rows use net_amount as credit/debit, but account_balance now uses gross (net_amount + advance_deduction). With taşeron hakediş subtotal 50000, advance_deduction 20000 (net 30000) and 20000 avans paid: statement final running balance = 10000 while account.balance = 30000. Avans is effectively deducted twice in the statement (once in net, once as avans row). Fix: in statement() use h['net_amount'] + h.get('advance_deduction',0) for hakediş rows (or show advance_deduction as separate line).

minor.issue: Ignores h.apply_overhead: a müşteri hakediş created with apply_overhead=false still creates a 6% virman on approval; also update_progress recalculates virman amount without checking apply_overhead. Confirm intended business rule.

Overhead virman has kasa_from=null, so it adds 6% to genel_gider without reducing any other kasa -> 'Toplam Kasa' is inflated by all overhead amounts (dashboard toplam 5.169.045 includes 171.000 virtual). Confirm whether Toplam Kasa should exclude fon kasalar.
Kasa column hardcodes 'Devrantaş Çek' if cek else 'Devrantaş Nakit' — custom kasalar (banka) shown as Nakit.
Error message for invalid kasa still says 'Kasa nakit veya çek olmalı' though kasalar are dynamic now.

ui_bugs.issue: %6 virman rows (Hakediş No X — %6 genel gider payı) show the delete (trash) button, but backend always returns 400 for linked virman deletes. Hide delete for t.type==='virman' && t.progress_payment_id.

Only remaining failure: statement balance mismatch with advance_deduction.
rca of the issue: Repro: taşeron T, approved avans gider 20000; taşeron hakediş subtotal 50000 vat 0 advance_deduction 20000 -> net 30000; approve. GET /api/accounts/T/statement: rows hakediş credit 30000, avans debit 20000 -> balance 10000; account.balance (core.account_balance uses net+advance_deduction=50000 minus paid 20000) = 30000. Root cause: routers/accounts.py statement() line ~114 uses h['net_amount']. Mitigation: use r2(h['net_amount'] + (h.get('advance_deduction') or 0)).
